comments.author: @JustAPrayer
comments.text:
I know people who work in restaurants have it hard, but yelling at people for not paying tips is absolute entitlement and messed up. I used to believe the excuses that if we didn’t tip the price of food would go up, but now food prices have risen and tipping has not changed it’s just increased as well.
And when servers tells me they have to pay out of their wage to cover the difference, that just makes me more incredulous. Your boss is stealing from you and making you take money out of your own paycheck to cover fees they don’t want to pay, and somehow the blame and anger is not directed to the boss but to the customers. That makes no sense.

comments.author: @bernieh6571
comments.text: I'm in my 60's.... when I was young tip was a reward for doing more than the job you're paid for..... which is bringning the food to the table..... I remember my dad once said " this one won't get a tip " talking about the waitress who acted like she was serving food to her cat..... no smile no manners no help !  Tip has become an obligation....

comments.author: @Peter-uk6pt
comments.text: Some restaurants tried to get rid of tipping (paid the staff well and had honest pricing) and the customers revolted so the restaurants went back to tipping.  Do Americans have a case of Stockholm syndrome when it comes to tipping?
